decision_rationale: The record describes scFoundation/xTrimoGene as a pretrained 100M-parameter transformer with an encoder-decoder architecture trained on an RDA de-masking task and used to generate masked gene expression values. It is foundation-model-like because it was pretrained on over 50 million scRNA-seq profiles and applied across multiple downstream tasks.
